surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the self-terminating and self-limiting gas-surface reactions of trimethylaluminum (TMA) and plasma-generated nitrogen radicals. The TMA pulse is followed by a purge step, and then a plasma pulse of nitrogen/argon to complete the surface reaction. The growth is self-limited due to the saturation of surface reaction sites, and the process is repeated in cycles to build up the AlN layer.
